title: Image to Base64
h1: Convert Image to Base64 Online — Free & Private
seoTitle: Image to Base64 Converter — Free Online Tool
description: Convert JPG, PNG, WebP or any image to a Base64 data URL or string. Everything runs in your browser so your image is never uploaded.
intro: Drop an image and instantly get its Base64 representation. Perfect for embedding images in HTML, CSS, emails or JSON without hosting a file.
blurb: Turn any image into a Base64 data URL without uploading it.
howItWorks: Click the upload area or drag and drop an image file (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF).
The tool reads the file locally with the FileReader API and converts it to a data URL.
Copy the Base64 string and paste it wherever you need an embedded image.
examples: Use the data URL as a CSS background-image: url(data:image/png;base64,...).
Embed a small logo inside a JSON configuration file.
Share image data in plain text when file upload is not available.

faq.q: Is my image uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Conversion uses the browser's FileReader and never leaves your device.
Any image format the browser can display: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, AVIF and more.

faq.q: Why is the output so long?
faq.a: Base64 encoding increases size by roughly 33 percent. Large images produce very long strings.
